nodes.label: Microsoft
nodes.description: Largest outside investor in OpenAI, per the source.

properties.summary: Microsoft is a technology company that invested in OpenAI and holds a stake in OpenAI Group PBC, reportedly being its largest outside investor. It also provides Azure cloud services and holds rights to sell OpenAI models.

nodes.label: OpenAI
nodes.description: Subject of the governance summary; a public benefit corporation's parent group.

properties.summary: OpenAI is an AI company whose restructured partnership with Microsoft is described in sources, and which depends on Microsoft's Azure cloud for computing power. Filings describe it as a public benefit corporation within a parent group.

nodes.label: OpenAI Group PBC
nodes.description: A public benefit corporation named in the governance summary.

properties.summary: OpenAI Group PBC is a public benefit corporation named in governance filings. Dailytech.example reports that Microsoft holds a stake of about 27% in the entity.

nodes.label: OpenAI Foundation
nodes.description: Entity holding power to appoint all board members of OpenAI Group PBC.

properties.summary: OpenAI Foundation is a nonprofit entity described by sources as holding the power to appoint all board members of OpenAI Group PBC and retaining control over it. Sources agree on its governing role over OpenAI Group PBC.

nodes.label: Azure
nodes.description: Microsoft's cloud computing platform used by OpenAI.

properties.summary: Azure is Microsoft's cloud computing platform, which sources say is used by OpenAI. One source reports its revenue grew 40%, led by AI services.

properties.title: Opinion: Microsoft is really in charge

edges.description: Holds the power to appoint all members of the board of OpenAI Group PBC.
Described as OpenAI's largest outside investor.
Stated to be chief executive of OpenAI.
Under the restructured agreement, Microsoft holds a stake of about 27% in OpenAI Group PBC.
Source identifies Nadella as chief executive of Microsoft.
OpenAI depends on Azure cloud for most of its computing power.
Microsoft has exclusive rights to sell OpenAI models through Azure until 2032.

evidence.excerpt: Microsoft, OpenAI's largest outside investor, does not have a board seat and does not control OpenAI.
evidence.reasoning: Directly states Microsoft does not control OpenAI, bearing on the claim.

evidence.excerpt: The OpenAI Foundation holds the power to appoint all members of the board of directors of OpenAI Group PBC.
evidence.reasoning: Identifies who holds board appointment power, relevant to the control question.

evidence.excerpt: Microsoft holds a stake of about 27% in OpenAI Group PBC.
evidence.reasoning: States Microsoft's equity stake, relevant to whether Microsoft controls OpenAI.

evidence.excerpt: The OpenAI Foundation, a nonprofit, retains control of the company and appoints its board.
evidence.reasoning: States that a different entity, the OpenAI Foundation, retains control, bearing directly on the claim.

evidence.excerpt: Critics argue that Microsoft has effective control over OpenAI's strategy because of this dependence.
evidence.reasoning: States the opinion that Microsoft controls OpenAI, though it is framed as critics' argument rather than fact.

evidence.excerpt: Microsoft has exclusive rights to sell OpenAI models through Azure until 2032.
evidence.reasoning: Describes a contractual relationship between Microsoft and OpenAI that bears on the claim of control.

evidence.excerpt: Microsoft reported quarterly revenue of $77.7 billion.
evidence.reasoning: Reports Microsoft's revenue, but says nothing about OpenAI or control over it, so it does not bear on the claim.

assessments.explanation: 1 independent source(s) support and 2 contradict the claim (weighted 0.40 vs 1.20).

sources.title: Microsoft and OpenAI rework partnership
sources.content: Microsoft has invested roughly $13 billion in OpenAI since 2019. Under the restructured agreement, Microsoft holds a stake of about 27% in OpenAI Group PBC. The OpenAI Foundation, a nonprofit, retains control of the company and appoints its board. Satya Nadella, chief executive of Microsoft, said the partnership remains strong.

sources.title: OpenAI Group PBC: governance summary
sources.content: OpenAI Group PBC is a public benefit corporation. The OpenAI Foundation holds the power to appoint all members of the board of directors of OpenAI Group PBC. Microsoft, OpenAI's largest outside investor, does not have a board seat and does not control OpenAI. Sam Altman is chief executive of OpenAI.

sources.title: Opinion: Microsoft is really in charge
sources.content: OpenAI depends on Microsoft's Azure cloud for most of its computing power. Critics argue that Microsoft has effective control over OpenAI's strategy because of this dependence. Microsoft has exclusive rights to sell OpenAI models through Azure until 2032.

sources.title: Azure growth beats estimates
sources.content: Microsoft reported quarterly revenue of $77.7 billion. Azure revenue grew 40%, led by AI services.
